name: io.github.reggiebro/hermes-micro-agent
title: Hermes Micro-Agent
description: 20 paid AI and data micro-tasks over x402 (HTTP 402) on Base: summarize, extract, keywords, sentiment, translate, rewrite, proofread, code_lint, code_explain, code_refactor, code_review, python_debug, json_minify, json_query, csv_to_json, hash, base64, convert, describe_image, probe_media. Free tools (tasks, price, verify, health) let an agent price and verify a call before paying. Every paid call is verified on-chain before execution; unimplemented tasks are refused, never faked.
